input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale:
A full-text search for "insurance" returns no results, and the miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30) contain no insurance covenant. TrueLink hosts the Client web site, operates the Interface and processes Client Content and consumer credit data, so it is exactly the type of vendor the playbook expects to carry coverage; the absence of any coverage is walk-away territory under the rule. We inserted a new Section 31 at the preferred levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), placed after Force Majeure so the existing numbering and the Section 24 survival reference are undisturbed, and flagged the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback in the comment.</parationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.86

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering TrueLink's processing of Client Content and other Client data; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink hosts our web site and processes Client data, but the Agreement carries no insurance covenant. We have added a standard insurance section (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request); if helpful, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Insert insurance covenant requiring TrueLink to maintain CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation coverage with certificates on request.
